services.name: Hays Campground
services.desc: Discover the ultimate outdoor haven at Hays Campground, nestled in the heart of a picturesque hamlet. Here, you'll find a plethora of enticing activities to delight in, including eight conveniently equipped power stalls, complimentary firewood, an electric-powered kitchen area, a sprawling lush expanse, a cosy picnic shelter, and idyllic tent sites. For those seeking adventure, Scope Dam offers fantastic fishing opportunities, while golf enthusiasts can tee off nearby, and nature lovers can explore captivating walking trails.
